results.title: Bilcare GCS expands US facility - Pharmaceutical Business review
results.snippet: Vincent Maria, Bilcare GCS Americas president, said: "The increase in storage capacity is the latest in a series of global upgrades designed to demonstrate to customers that Bilcare is a company focused on providing high quality service and cutting edge technology for its customers to ensure on time project completion."
